text:
sara: Heads-up — postmortem follow-ups for last week's KV cache OOM. I want a short owner + ETA for each action so we can close the loop before Friday.

mike: Thanks. I'll own the profiler job and the leak hypothesis validation. ETA EOD Thu.

devon: Taking GC tuning experiments (thresholds + conservative compaction). I can run a 48h canary starting tomorrow.

leo: I'll add hard limits to the shard allocator and wire up alerting for alloc drift. Planning to open the PR today.

rachel: I'll coordinate the customer-impact checklist and update runbooks for the fallback policy. ETA Fri morning.

sara: Great. Quick checklist: 1) reproduce locally or in stage (mike) 2) GC/compaction experiments (devon) 3) allocator limits + alerts (leo) 4) runbook + customer comms (rachel) 5) spike detection dashboard (infra)

mike: Repro notes — I can repro on a 4-shard stage with synthetic TTL churn. Command I used:

```bash
./bin/run_kv_load --shards 4 --ttl-burst 1000 --workload churn
```

mike: logs show steady resident growth even after forced compaction. attaching snippet: `rss +8MB/min over 40m`

devon: Interesting. Could be KV fragmentation + lingering refs from prefetched prefixes. I'll instrument prefix refs count.

leo: PR #2487 opened to add max_shard_rss and an eviction guard, plus an alert rule: `shard_rss > max_shard_rss * 0.9 for 5m`. Requesting review from @devon and @mike.

infra-bot: deploy-job/kv-guard v1.2 started by leo — build 8842 queued.

rachel: For runbook, question: do we want automatic fallback to smaller model variants when OOM risk detected, or prefer throttled writes and manual rollback?

sara: Prefer automatic fallback for public-facing routes, throttled writes for internal jobs. Add both options to the runbook with clear rollback steps.

mike: Update on repro: after adding an extra GC trigger (mem pressure trigger) rss stops increasing but throughput drops 15%. Need to quantify cost tradeoff.

devon: That's expected. Compaction is expensive. I'll try a staggered compaction schedule to reduce tail impact and report perf numbers.

leo: Alerting is in place on stage. I'll promote to prod config after reviews. Will post PR/rollout window.

rachel: Drafted a short customer note and escalation steps. Will share in #customer-success for signoff.

sara: Thanks team. Please paste final owner+ETA into this thread once you have them. I'll run a short scrub on Friday to mark items done or move to next sprint. :thumbsup:

mike: Owner:mike, Task:profiler + repro verification, ETA: 2026-03-25 EOD

devon: Owner:devon, Task:GC experiments + staggered compaction, ETA: 2026-03-26 midday

leo: Owner:leo, Task:shard_rss guard + alerts + rollout, ETA: 2026-03-24 EOD

rachel: Owner:rachel, Task:runbook + customer note, ETA: 2026-03-27 AM

infra-bot: reminder: recurring-checklist memory-followup scheduled for 2026-03-28 09:00 UTC

sara: Perfect — will consolidate into the PM tracker and close the loop. If anything slips, flag it here.
